seen.where: PARES record 67815 (AGI ESTADO,86B,N.100), fetched by curl on 3 Nov 2026 with a fresh cookie jar (show page, then ViewImage.do at zoom 10, 3 s apart): description page read; images 20, 59, 79, 96-101, 104, 108, 112, 116, 118 fetched and viewed
seen.extent: 215 images. The description marks three ciphered letters 'Carta cifrada. Descifrada entre lineas' (no. 4 Moscow 20 Nov 1767; no. 8 St Petersburg 8 Mar 1773, letter 37; no. 15 St Petersburg 1773, letter 70) and item 11 'Copia descifrada de la carta no. 52'. Image 79 is a full leaf of digit groups with a line of Spanish written under each digit line; images 96-101 are about 20 lines each of bare digit groups (letter 52); image 108 is the clear Spanish copy about Popov (the descifrada copy of letter 52). Image 59 returned the PARES blank-image placeholder.
seen.cipher: Image 79 shows digit groups separated by dots and slashes with the decipherment written between the lines ('tres embarcaciones al mismo intento', 'Puso dos al mando del Capitan ...'): the interlinear decipherment is on the leaf. The bare-digit pages 96-101 belong to letter 52, whose decipherment is the separate clear copy at image 108. So the ciphers in this file all carry a contemporary decipherment.
